items.en: «Ukrainian Drone Operators Strike russian Buk-M1 Air Defense System on the Huliaipole Axis (Video)» (Defense Express: 'Ukrainian drone operators strike Russian Buk-M1 air defence system on the Huliaipole axis')
items.nl: Oekraïense droneoperators raken Russisch Buk-M1-luchtafweersysteem bij Hoeljajpole
items.sEn: Drone operators of Ukraine's 433rd Regiment struck a Russian Buk-M1 surface-to-air missile system on the Huliaipole axis, Defense Express reports, based on footage released by the 7th Corps of Ukraine's Air Assault Forces.
